name: Vatari Guggulu

sections.introduction: Vatari Guggulu is an ayurvedic medicine in tablet form that includes Guggulu ( Commiphora mukul ) as its base. Vatari taila is referred as Castor oil. It can pacify Vata and Kapha Doshas. Hence it is used in the treatment of Vata disorders like arthritis, aches and pains etc.
sections.ingredients:
Vatari taila – Castor oil 
 Shuddha Gandhaka 
 Triphala – Haritaki – Terminalia chebula , Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica , Amla – Emblica officinalis 
 Guggulu – Purified Commiphora mukul . 

 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients including Castor oil, Shuddha Gandhaka and Triphala are powdered with Guggulu and then rolled into tablet forms of uniform size of 500 mg.
sections.dosage: Consume 1-2 tablets 2-3 times a day, before or after meals or as recommended by Ayurvedic doctor. Usually instructed for 2 – 3 months.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
Ayurvedic treatment for rheumatoid arthritis and hip pain. 
 Even very good use in chronic degenerative diseases. 
 Provides relief from joint pain and swelling as well as joint stiffness. 
 Recovers the appetite and digestion. 
 Body detoxifier. 
 Useful remedy for gout, Paraplegia, limping and sciatica. 
 Deformed knee due to chronic arthritis. 
 Controls lower backache pain. 
 Relieves the Burning sensation.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
It is better to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dose than prescribed may lead to stomach irritation. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Vatari Guggulu 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali – Amavata adhikara 87 – 89 
 Introduction 
 Vatari Guggulu is an ayurvedic medicine in tablet form that includes Guggulu ( Commiphora mukul ) as its base. Vatari taila is referred as Castor oil. It can pacify Vata and Kapha Doshas. Hence it is used in the treatment of Vata disorders like arthritis, aches and pains etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Vatari taila – Castor oil 
 Shuddha Gandhaka 
 Triphala – Haritaki – Terminalia chebula , Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica , Amla – Emblica officinalis 
 Guggulu – Purified Commiphora mukul . 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients including Castor oil, Shuddha Gandhaka and Triphala are powdered with Guggulu and then rolled into tablet forms of uniform size of 500 mg. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 1-2 tablets 2-3 times a day, before or after meals or as recommended by Ayurvedic doctor. Usually instructed for 2 – 3 months. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Ayurvedic treatment for rheumatoid arthritis and hip pain. 
 Even very good use in chronic degenerative diseases. 
 Provides relief from joint pain and swelling as well as joint stiffness. 
 Recovers the appetite and digestion. 
 Body detoxifier. 
 Useful remedy for gout, Paraplegia, limping and sciatica. 
 Deformed knee due to chronic arthritis. 
 Controls lower backache pain. 
 Relieves the Burning sensation. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 It is better to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dose than prescribed may lead to stomach irritation. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
